notes: Original interpretive MBTA-style vehicles. Western Green-B/C/D/E branches use separate directed OSM tracks and MBTA station names/positions. B/C/D terminate at the Blandford Street, Saint Mary’s Street and Fenway subway portals; E ends north of Northeastern. Short D branch underpasses are retained as covered spans. The D is clipped at the Brookline/Newton boundary; northern Green Line extensions and the central subway are not modeled. Buses follow the typical MBTA pattern of each listed route in both directions, clipped to the playable coverage (coveragePercent records how much of the source shape is kept); destination signs show the MBTA headsign. Operating speed, dwell, traffic behavior and frequency are game assumptions; no real-time service or timetable.
